sites.name: Cinder Cone Fort
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: no pad of this composition exists; 120 x 120 m on the crater's west rim, with the crater floor as its inner yard (the CIS Flower Tower is 93 x 88 m)
sites.stake: The fort in the cone's crater is the gate of the only vehicle road onto Ember Crescent

sites.name: Mole Rock Gate
sites.comp: CIS Double Pcannon Checkpoint with GPs
sites.size_note: KNOWN: 1-14 / A1-11 (a through-comp: the trunk runs through it)
sites.stake: A gun checkpoint on Mole Rock, the basalt islet where the causeway bends (through-comp, starts closed); taking it lets vehicles reach the cone

sites.name: Cone Flank Batteries (artillery base)
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: as the CIS Small Artillery Base (1-M3)
sites.stake: Guns on the east flank cover both causeways; air softens them

sites.name: Cone Flank Batteries (tower)
sites.stake: Guns on the east flank cover both causeways; air softens them

sites.name: Skerry AA Platform
sites.comp: CIS Mixed AA Platform with GPs
sites.stake: Shoots LAATs on the eastern run into the caldera; taking it opens the eastern air route
sites.entrance_note: faces the water (a sea / beach work)

sites.name: North Causeway Gun
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: 30 x 30 m beside the trunk on the north causeway
sites.stake: A gun tower on the north causeway; silencing it opens the causeway to vehicles

sites.name: Cone Quarry
sites.stake: Quarry pits give the fort's mortar crews a covered firing line on the south causeway; taking them stops those mortars

sites.name: Lava Flow Trench
sites.stake: A trench on the west lava flow covers the north causeway

sites.name: South Foot Depot
sites.comp: CIS Medium Logistics Base with GPs
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: between Supply Base Small_1 (82 x 65 m) and the Medium FOB (78 x 149 m)
sites.stake: Where the south causeway lands on the cone: the fort's supply. Taking it gives the fort's gate code (intel)

sites.name: Skerry Bunkers
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: 50 x 50 m (your 1-05 with this pick was built as a Small Citadel, 148 x 153 m)
sites.stake: Bunkers on the outer skerry guard the AA platform's landing
sites.entrance_note: faces the water (a sea / beach work)

sites.name: Flat Pillboxes
sites.size_note: KNOWN as built: your 1-09 with this pick is a Small Rectangle FOB, 90 x 58 m
sites.stake: Pillboxes on a dry bank enfilade the south causeway

sites.name: Crescent Foot Fuel
sites.stake: Fuel for vehicles on the causeway road; it burns when hit

sites.name: Causeway Foot AA
sites.comp: Tukata Air Defense Tower with GPs
sites.stake: Covers the causeway landfall; taking it lets LAATs land at Causeway Foot

sites.name: South Arm Road Checkpoint
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: as the CIS Small Checkpoint (A2-05)
sites.stake: The road west toward the south arm and the dam; taking it opens op 8's south road

sites.name: East Slope Comms
sites.stake: Comms on the crescent's outer slope; taking it gives intel on the Yard's shifts

sites.name: Steam Vent Bores
sites.size_note: REDUCED: the composition's own pad (2-14) is 192 x 166 m and nothing that big holds 4 m on the cone's north skirt; a 120 x 100 m pad fits (needs a smaller cut of the facility)
sites.stake: Geothermal bores on the cone's north skirt power the fort; blowing them darkens its guns' radars. Heat plumes

sites.name: Black Beach Landers
sites.comp: CIS Big Lander FOB with GPs
sites.size_note: ASSUMED: 120 x 160 m; a beach work (may come to the water's edge)
sites.stake: A lander FOB on the cone's north beach; taking it opens that beach to boats

trunk_breaks.label: the south causeway's south end (3.5 m); the join up to op 2's net is a 20 m step that needs your ramp
the north causeway's cone end (3.5 m); the climb from here onto the cone is a 45 m step that needs your ramp

4-F Cinder Cone Fort: by the trunk road over the south causeway, through the Mole Rock Gate and up the cone's south side (vehicles)
from the north causeway or the cone's north beach (the landers) up the cone's north-west side, on foot or on the trunk
4-M1 Mole Rock Gate: along the south causeway from the Airfield Terrace (vehicles, on the trunk)
by boat to Mole Rock's own shore (see shores)
4-M2 Cone Flank Batteries: by boat to the cone's east shore below the batteries
along the cone's east flank road from the South Foot Depot (vehicles)
4-M3 Causeway Foot: over the north causeway from the cone (vehicles, on the trunk)
by boat to the beach south of the town, or down the slope road from the north
4-M4 Skerry AA Platform: by boat to the skerry's landing below the bunkers (4-05)
by air once the platform's own AA is suppressed from the cone (no LZ given)
